blocks.text: SAN JOSE — Australia’s teen social media ban and efforts to rein in AI will be selling points in a pitch to gain a place on the United Nations Security Council. Anthony Albanese will launch Australia’s official campaign for a seat on the powerful body in New York late on Sunday, Australian time, ahead of a week of meetings with global leaders at the UN General Assembly high-level week. Australia is seeking a two-year term on the security council in 2029 and 2030 as one of the 10 non-permanent members of the 15-seat body. A vote for the positions will not […]...
